info.title: Shortfall Bridge AI
info.description: Drug shortage therapeutic substitution decision support grounded in FDA labelling. Authenticate with `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer` when the deployment sets `SFB_API_KEYS`.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Optional caller labels (bed or episode), same order

BatchRequest.title: BatchRequest
BatchRequest.description: Up to 25 requests evaluated together, for example every patient on a ward affected by one shortage.

CandidateTier.title: CandidateTier
CandidateTier.description: Substitution tiers, ordered from least to most clinical disruption.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Decision support only. Verify every substitution against the current product label, local formulary and the patient record before prescribing, dispensing or administering.

RenalEstimate.title: RenalEstimate
RenalEstimate.description: Renal function the engine used, and how it was obtained.

ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision
ReviewDecision.description: Pharmacist review outcome recorded against one ranked option.

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description: A pharmacist's agreement or override for one option of a stored recommendation.

ScoreTerm.title: ScoreTerm
ScoreTerm.description: One additive term of a candidate's rank score, shown so the ranking is fully explainable.

SectionType.title: SectionType
SectionType.description: Label sections indexed for retrieval, aligned to openFDA label fields and SPL LOINC codes.

Sex.title: Sex
Sex.description: Sex used only by creatinine clearance and eGFR equations (Cockcroft-Gault, CKD-EPI 2021).

ShortageRecord.title: ShortageRecord
ShortageRecord.description: One presentation level entry from the FDA Drug Shortages database.
